name: Broken Alliances
label: Quest
description: In Kargath, Gorn wants the Horde's honor restored after its alliance with Deathwing. The ogre Boss Tho'grun, hired to help get the Sign of the Earth…
intro: In Kargath, Gorn wants the Horde's honor restored after its alliance with Deathwing. The ogre Boss Tho'grun, hired to help get the Sign of the Earth, turned on the Horde and kept it for himself, and you are to take it back at Camp Boff.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: From the Horde's alliance with the dragon Deathwing during the Second War, we know that two of his lieutenants, Blacklash and Hematus, were imprisoned within Lethlor Ravine far to the east. We must silence our depraved allies of old to restore honor to the Horde!

We hired Tho'grun and his band of ogre mercenaries to help us obtain the Sign of the Earth, a key needed to unlock the drakes' prison. Tho'grun betrayed us though, overwhelming us and taking it for himself. Go to Camp Boff and take it back!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Tho'grun's betrayal... Is there any wonder why the ogres are part of the Horde no longer? I will be glad to see him dead, and the Sign of the Earth returned.
If you've not dispatched him yet, then waste no time going to Camp Boff. It is to the southeast of Kargath.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With Tho'grun dead, his corpse picked clean by the desert winds and scavenging buzzards, the ogres will be put into disarray. Though a small victory, this will lead to a much larger one
The Sign of the Earth is now in our possession, and we can open the black drakes' prison in Lethlor. We shall free them from endless imprisonment, albeit to their doom!
